scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @ghost/shared && npm run dev -w @ghost/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @ghost/shared && npm run dev -w @ghost/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ghost/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:server && npm run test:web
